original: THE UNREAL WORLD
translation: 虚幻世界

original: Scenario: THE UNREAL WORLD
translation: 开局：虚幻世界

original: Start playing at the middle of a wide, unfamiliar wilderness.
translation: 从一片广阔而陌生的荒野腹地开始游戏。

original: At the age of sixteen you've left your home and village.  During  your  childhood  and adolescent years you have learnt the skills and ways of your people until you decided it was time for you to go search for a path of your own, whatever it might be. Your journey took you far away and the further you went, the more you learned. Even though much had passed on from your father to you,there would be many things that you must learn on your own. The lore of your people would help you,  and so would the equipment and supplies  you  had gotten from your family - but still feelings of insecurity seemed to bother you from time to time. One morning you stood still for a long time and listened to the wilderness humming  around you. Last night you had woken up to the sound of  wolves howling  at  the  moon.  After  that  you had travelled a long time in the dark. "That wasn't a good idea at all", you thought, standing in the middle of a totally strange and unknown area. Just as you felt over the past few days, you didn't know what you were doing or where  you were headed. Your path was taking you somewhere - but exactly where was still to become clear to you. (This scenario doesn't give you any advantages or disadvantages  or  even  a  clear plot to start playing. It just simply sends you on your way into the UnReal World.)
translation: 十六岁时，你离开了家和村庄。童年与少年时代，你学会了族人的技艺与生活方式，直到你觉得该去寻找自己的道路了——无论那会是一条怎样的路。旅途把你带到了远方，你走得越远，学到的就越多。虽然父亲传授给你许多知识，但仍有许多事情必须靠自己摸索。族人的传统知识会帮助你，家人给你的装备和补给也一样；可不安的感觉仍不时困扰着你。一天清晨，你久久伫立，倾听周围荒野的低鸣。昨夜，你被群狼对月长嚎的声音惊醒，随后在黑暗中走了很久。“那可真不是个好主意。”你站在一片完全陌生的地方，这样想着。就像过去几天一样，你不知道自己在做什么，也不知道要去哪里。这条路正把你带向某处，可究竟是哪里，你还不清楚。（这个开局不会给你任何优势或劣势，甚至没有明确的起始剧情。它只是让你踏上进入虚幻世界的旅程。）

original: THE VILLAGE
translation: 村庄

original: Scenario: THE VILLAGE
translation: 开局：村庄

original: Start playing outside a strange but cosy-looking village.
translation: 从一座陌生却看起来舒适的村庄外开始游戏。

original: At the age of sixteen you've left your home and village.  During  your  childhood  and  adolescent years you have learnt the skills and ways of your people until you decided it was time for you  to go search for a path of your own, whatever it might be. One day a small party of men from your village were about to go on trading journey to some  far away tribes.  They promised to lead you to the village that was on their way if  so  wished,  from where it would be more safe for you to start living on your own. And so it was. The party left you standing outside the village as they continued on  their way. Houses in the village seemed very cosy after the long trip but about the  people you  weren't  too sure.  You knew that you hadn't come here just to settle down again,  but it would probably  be  a good idea to see what the village had to offer before rushing ahead. (Starting at the village provides a safe way to  start  playing.  You  may  equip  your  character carefully  before  going  out  to  the  wilderness and have a safe place to return to if you face setbacks or dangers on your journeys.)
translation: 十六岁时，你离开了家和村庄。童年与少年时代，你学会了族人的技艺与生活方式，直到你觉得该去寻找自己的道路了——无论那会是一条怎样的路。一天，村里的一小队男子准备前往遥远的部族做买卖。他们答应，只要你愿意，就带你去途经的一座村庄，让你能从一个更安全的地方开始独立生活。事情就这样定了。他们继续赶路，把你留在村外。经过漫长的旅途，村中的房屋显得十分温暖舒适，但这里的人如何，你还拿不准。你知道，来这里并不是为了再次定居，不过在贸然上路前，先看看村里有什么可供利用的东西，大概是个好主意。（从村庄起步是一种安全的开局方式。你可以在前往荒野前仔细置办装备；旅途中遇到挫折或危险时，也有一个安全的地方可以返回。）

original: AGRICULTURE
translation: 农耕

original: Scenario: AGRICULTURE
translation: 开局：农耕

original: You posses some valuable seeds and are ready to try out your agricultural skills.
translation: 你拥有一些珍贵的种子，准备试试自己的农耕本领。

original: At the age of sixteen you left your home not only with some clothes, weapons and necessary equipment but also with some valuable seeds. When you find a nice place to settle down you can start growing your own crops. (You have some turnip seeds, peas and a shovel with you. That's everything needed to try growing your own crops.)
translation: 十六岁离家时，你带走的不只是衣服、武器和必要装备，还有一些珍贵的种子。找到合适的落脚处后，你就能开始种植自己的庄稼。（你带着一些芜菁种子、豌豆和一把铲。这就是尝试自己种庄稼所需的一切。）

original: THERE BE ROBBERS!
translation: 强盗出没！

original: Scenario: THERE BE ROBBERS!
translation: 开局：强盗出没！

original: You encounter a band of ruffians in the wilderness.
translation: 你在荒野中遇到一伙恶徒。

original: Throughout your childhood you loved to listen to the fireside stories of adventurers and hunters telling of life beyond your small village's borders. At a very young age you decided that you would one day set out on your own looking for adventure and excitement in the wide wilderness. After leaving your family and home you've seen a bit of the world and had a bit of excitement as well, but one day adventure found you instead. While wandering along minding your own business you look up to see a band of ruffians approaching. They haven't offered you violence yet, but the potential for it is in their eyes and their hands resting on weapons. Will you try to run, hand over your meager belongings, or stand your ground against the mob and risk injury or even death? (This scenario puts you face to face with possible danger. Will you take the offensive or try to escape with your skin intact? The next step is up to you. Keeping your starting equipment means risking your life and fighting the bandits off.)
translation: 从小，你就喜欢听冒险者和猎人在炉火旁讲故事，讲述小村庄之外的生活。年纪很小时，你便决定，总有一天要独自出发，去广阔荒野中寻找冒险和刺激。离开家人与家园后，你见过一些世面，也经历过一些刺激，可有一天，冒险反而主动找上了你。你原本只是自顾自地走着，一抬头，却看见一伙恶徒正迎面而来。他们尚未动手，但眼神与搭在武器上的手已透露出暴力的可能。你会尝试逃跑、交出那点可怜的财物，还是坚守原地对抗这群人，冒着受伤乃至丧命的危险？（这个开局让你直面潜在的危险。你会主动进攻，还是设法全身而退？下一步由你决定。想保住起始装备，就得冒着生命危险击退这些强盗。）

original: NOT ALL WHO WANDER ARE LOST
translation: 流浪者并非全都迷途

original: Scenario: NOT ALL WHO WANDER ARE LOST
translation: 开局：流浪者并非全都迷途

original: You set out into the unforgiving wilderness with a four-legged companion.
translation: 你与一位四足伙伴一起踏入严酷的荒野。

original: Life wasn't easy growing up, just you and your parents on a lonely homestead in the wilderness. Game was scarce in the area you had settled. Fish avoided your nets. It seemed even the spirits themselves frowned on your move from the familiar village of your birth. First wild animals broke through the rickety fence protecting your crops, destroying the spring planting. Then wolves came in the night and attacked your few animals in their pens, killing most and scattering the survivors. You set out at dawn to look for signs of your animals while your parents struggled to rebuild, hoping you could still build a successful homestead. After two days combing the countryside you returned home with one straggling animal to find your father dead in the dooryard surrounded by the smoldering remains of everything you had managed to build. Your mother was gone, presumably taken. Left alone with only the supplies and tools you carry and your four-legged companion you set out into the unforgiving wilderness, just another wanderer looking for their place in the UnReal World. (In this scenario you start out with equipment and an animal companion common to your culture. What you make of this world is your own choice. Travel well and may the spirits smile upon you.)
translation: 成长的日子并不容易，只有你和父母住在荒野中孤零零的农庄里。定居的地方猎物稀少，鱼儿也不肯入网。你们离开了熟悉的出生村庄，仿佛连精灵也不赞同这个决定。先是野兽冲破保护庄稼的破旧围栏，毁掉了春播的作物。接着狼群在夜里袭来，攻击围栏内仅有的几头牲畜，杀死了大半，幸存的也四散逃走。黎明时，你出门寻找牲畜的踪迹，父母则艰难地修复家园，希望仍能建成一座兴旺的农庄。你在乡野搜寻了两天，带着一头掉队的牲畜回家，却发现父亲死在门前的院子里，周围是你们辛苦建起的一切仍在冒烟的残骸。母亲不见了，很可能被人掳走。如今只剩你独自一人，带着随身的补给和工具，以及那位四足伙伴，再次走向严酷的荒野。你只是又一个流浪者，要在虚幻世界中寻找自己的归宿。（此开局会给你所属文化中常见的装备和一位动物伙伴。如何在这个世界生活，由你自己选择。愿你旅途平安，愿精灵眷顾你。）

original: RUNAWAY SLAVE
translation: 逃奴

original: Scenario: RUNAWAY SLAVE
translation: 开局：逃奴

original: Having been slave to Njerpezit for years you finally take a step to escape from your captors.
translation: 被 Njerpezit 奴役多年后，你终于迈出了逃离掳掠者的第一步。

original: You have few memories of your parents, your home and your life as a free,  happy  youngster.  Then there are the memories of a sudden attack... terror and  burning  houses...  memories  of  Njerpez warriors dragging you away with a few crying wives and other young men, barely alive,  through the forest. You were taken far away and from there on you could neither hear nor see  people  of  your own. You grew up as a slave. On your rare spare time you secretly  took  care  of  ways,  skills  and language of your own. Someday, you swore, you would escape and return home. A change came upon you as the Njerpez village you were  brought  to  started  to  talk  about  a looting expedition at an area that had lived at peace for years: your late home-area. Few  slaves, including you, were also taken to take part in the expedition. You travelled first with a large party but as soon as you were no longer  on  Njerpez  territory you separated into smaller groups.Once, as your party had encamped, you were sent nearby to gather some firewood with a young guard. At that point you decided to take action. You attacked the young Njerpez bare-handed, managed to knock him down, and quickly  grabbed  his weapon from him and stabbed him dead. You started to run away aimlessly  through  the  forest  but soon ended up in the middle of another Njerpez camp! Was your escape going to end like this? No - you were desperate and if you were  ever  going  to get free it would be now... (You are lightly dressed,  carrying only few weapons.  If you manage to escape,  surviving  in the wilderness like this, without supplies, may get very hard. On  the  other hand  fighting  against superior enemy may be more foolish - even though they are carrying equipment you too could use.)
translation: 你对父母、家园，以及曾经自由快乐的少年生活，已没有多少记忆。随后浮现的，是突如其来的袭击……恐惧与燃烧的房屋……Njerpez 战士拖着你、几个哭泣的妇女和其他奄奄一息的年轻男子穿过森林。你被带往很远的地方，从此再也看不到、听不到自己的族人。你作为奴隶长大。在难得的空闲中，你偷偷守护着本族的习俗、技艺和语言。你发誓，总有一天要逃走，回到家乡。机会终于来了：你所在的 Njerpez 村庄开始议论一次劫掠远征，目标是一个已和平生活多年的地区——你从前的家乡。包括你在内的几个奴隶，也被带去参加远征。起初你们跟着一支大队伍同行，一离开 Njerpez 领地，就分成了几支小队。一次扎营后，你被派去附近拾柴，一名年轻守卫随行。你决定就在此刻行动。你赤手空拳袭击了那个年轻的 Njerpez 人，设法将他击倒，迅速夺过武器，把他刺死。你漫无目的地穿林奔逃，却很快闯进了另一处 Njerpez 营地！难道逃亡就要这样结束？不——你已绝望；如果还有重获自由的机会，那就是现在……（你衣着单薄，只带着几件武器。即使成功逃脱，在毫无补给的荒野中生存也可能极其艰难。不过，与占据优势的敌人战斗也许更加愚蠢——尽管他们带着你也用得上的装备。）

original: UNFORTUNATE HUNTING TRIP
translation: 不幸的狩猎之旅

original: Scenario: UNFORTUNATE HUNTING TRIP
translation: 开局：不幸的狩猎之旅

original: Your father lies dead on the ground and the beast who killed him is still present.
translation: 父亲倒毙在地，杀死他的猛兽还在附近。

original: For as long as you can remember you had been eager to take part in the hunting trips that the  men of your home village regularly made. One day you were old enough to do so, and eagerly awaited the departure of the hunting party. You left with your father and a few other hunters and travelled further and further away as  the game you were tracking didn't seem to follow their usual annual course. After a week your father decided to take you back home, and satisfied that you  had  managed  to get few good kills, you agreed. The rest of the men continued the trip. You and your father had been heading back home for two days when you found a  fresh  half  eaten elk carcass. Unwilling to encounter the beast you changed your course a bit but  didn't  get  very far as your father, walking before you, stopped. "Wait... I heard something", he said.  You  knelt down, heart throbbing, and watched as your father silently sneaked ahead and  finally  disappeared behind a big tree. The forest was very silent for a moment, then a cry of your father was mixed with the  sound  of an attacking beast. You jumped to your feet and started to run towards the noise... You found your father lying on the ground and bleeding badly. "Son... you must go... it's a...", your father whispered - then he was gone. (Selecting this scenario gives you immediate fighting experience.  If you manage to kill the beast or even escape from it you are on your own in the middle of the wide, unfamiliar environment. The equipment of your late father may become very useful to you if you manage to pick them up  -  and that way even though you are alone in the world now, your family will be with you.)
translation: 从记事起，你就渴望参加村中男人定期进行的狩猎之旅。终于有一天，你的年纪足够了，便急切地等待猎队出发。你跟着父亲和另外几名猎人上路，越走越远，因为追踪的猎物似乎没有沿着往年惯常的路线行进。一周后，父亲决定带你回家。你已经猎获了几只不错的猎物，心满意足地答应了，其余人则继续狩猎。返程走了两天，你和父亲发现一具新鲜的、被吃掉一半的驼鹿尸体。为避开那头猛兽，你们稍稍改道，但没走多远，走在前面的父亲就停下了。“等等……我听到了什么。”他说。你跪伏下来，心怦怦直跳，看着父亲无声地潜行向前，最终消失在一棵大树后。森林沉寂了片刻，接着父亲的呼喊与猛兽扑击的声音混在一起。你猛然站起，朝声音传来的方向跑去……你发现父亲倒在地上，鲜血直流。“孩子……你必须走……那是……”父亲低声说道，随后便断了气。（这个开局会立刻让你经历战斗。无论杀死猛兽还是成功逃脱，之后你都将独自在广阔陌生的环境中生活。如果能取走亡父的装备，它们会对你大有帮助；这样，即使如今你孤身一人，家人也仍以另一种方式陪伴着你。）

original: LONELY SETTLER
translation: 孤独的拓荒者

original: Scenario: LONELY SETTLER
translation: 开局：孤独的拓荒者

original: You find yourself alone on a foreign ground with two unfinished cottages.
translation: 你独自在异乡，身边只有两间尚未建成的木屋。

original: "We aren't staying here any more!" said the thundering voice of your father as  there  had  been strange hunters and people at your home area lately. Your family lived alone,  two  day's  journey away from neighbouring families who were more open to newcomers, although your father  always  got into fights with them.  He didn't want your home area and  hunting  grounds  to  get  too  densely populated. It would bring problems, he knew, and so you left your old cottage and  its  few  sheds behind you. You travelled north - you, your father  and  mother  and  one  sheep,  carrying  only  the  most important tools and equipment. Finally, after a hard journey, your father was pleased with the new grounds you were at and you started to build a few cottages. During the next  weeks  your  mother, probably strained too much on your journey, caught a disease that made her weak and ill. The building was delayed and finally you had to kill your sheep to get  something  nutritious to eat. Luckily your mother got better soon. One morning your father woke you  up  and  told  you  to continue building. "I'll go to the big lake in the east", he said. "Your mother is in  the  forest performing rituals." You grabbed your axe and started to cut logs. At evening  you  realized  that  neither  of  your parents had returned. You got worried and called for them but got no reply,  nor  could  you  find them. That night was filled with anguish and despair, and the following days  brought  no  relief. You were alone - unknowing of what might have happened or what was going to happen... (You may want to finish the cottages on your own and settle here - whatever you do there's much to learn about life and making your livelihood. However, the area  where  your  father  brought  you feels like home to you now more than the unfamiliar wilderness around.)
translation: “我们不在这里住下去了！”父亲如雷般吼道。最近，家园附近出现了一些陌生猎人和其他外来者。你们一家独居于此，距邻居有两天路程。邻居对新来的人更宽容，父亲却总与他们争吵。他不希望家园和猎场变得人口稠密；他知道，那会带来麻烦。于是，你们离开了旧木屋和几座棚舍。你、父亲、母亲和一只羊向北出发，只携带最重要的工具与装备。经过艰苦的旅途，父亲终于满意于脚下的新土地，你们开始建造几间木屋。随后的几周里，母亲病了，变得虚弱不堪，也许是旅途太过劳累。建造工作耽搁下来，最终你们不得不杀掉那只羊，以获得一些滋补的食物。幸好，母亲很快好转。一天清晨，父亲叫醒你，让你继续建屋。“我去东边的大湖。”他说，“你母亲在森林里举行仪式。”你拿起斧子，开始砍伐原木。傍晚，你才发现父母都没有回来。你担忧地呼喊，却无人回应，也找不到他们。那一夜满是痛苦与绝望，随后几天也没有带来慰藉。你孤身一人，不知道发生了什么，也不知道未来会怎样……（你可以独自把木屋建完，在这里定居。无论怎么选择，生活与谋生都有许多东西要学。不过，与周围陌生的荒野相比，父亲带你来到的这片地方，如今更让你觉得像家。）

original: HURT, HELPLESS, AND AFRAID
translation: 伤重、无助而恐惧

original: Scenario: HURT, HELPLESS, AND AFRAID
translation: 开局：伤重、无助而恐惧

original: Wounded and left for dead, you struggle to survive in the wilderness.
translation: 你受伤后被当作死人丢下，只能在荒野中挣扎求生。

original: One cold night, as you were wandering through the wilderness, you were surrounded by a group of Njerpezit. You were hopelessly outnumbered, but you fought anyway. Remarkably, you slew two of the men as their blades pierced your flesh. However, there were too many, and you simply could not defeat them all. You stabbed yet another of the bandits with your knife, but as you withdrew your knife from his flesh, you were struck from behind, and fell unconscious. Hours passed. When you finally regained your consciousness, you found yourself alone; apparently, the Njerpezit had left you for dead. They had stripped you of your possessions, save for a couple pieces of clothing, and you discovered that your injuries prevented you from performing most tasks. Shivering in the cold, you began to crawl onward, your hand brushing your knife, which had somehow been lost in the struggle. (This is a difficult scenario, as you have suffered rather severe injuries, making you incapable of walking. You also lack anything but your knife and a few pieces of clothing. It is very possible to die from the injuries you have suffered. This scenario is recommended for advanced players only!)
translation: 一个寒冷的夜晚，你在荒野中行走，被一群 Njerpezit 包围。敌众我寡，毫无胜算，但你仍奋起抵抗。令人惊讶的是，尽管他们的刀刃刺穿了你的身体，你还是杀死了其中两人。然而敌人实在太多，你不可能全部击败。你又用刀刺中一名匪徒，可就在拔刀时，背后挨了一击，随即昏倒在地。数小时过去。你终于醒来，发现四下无人；显然，Njerpezit 以为你已经死了。他们抢走了你的财物，只留下几件衣服。你发现伤势让你几乎什么也做不了。你在寒冷中颤抖，开始向前爬去，手却碰到了自己的刀——它不知怎么在搏斗中掉落了。（这是一个艰难的开局。你的伤势相当严重，已经无法行走；除了刀和几件衣服外，你一无所有。你很可能死于这些伤势。仅推荐经验丰富的玩家选择！）

original: TRAPS AND TRAPPING
translation: 陷阱与设陷

original: Scenario: TRAPS AND TRAPPING
translation: 开局：陷阱与设陷

original: You start playing fully equipped with tools for passive hunting.
translation: 你带着用于被动狩猎的齐全工具开始游戏。

original: You are a foster child, raised by an aging trapper who had found you  in  the  forest  beside  his trap-path when you were four or five years old. Your exact age remains  a  mystery  as  does  your origin since you've no memories of times before your foster father, and  nor  could  he  tell  you anything special that would explain your early years. The only reason your foster father, Jussa, took you with him was that he was  getting  old  and had no son. Jussa was a skilled trapper and lived the life of a hermit  -  avoiding  contact  with anyone. Most of all he wanted the traps he had made to still be used after he had passed away. Naturally you became interested about traps and making  your  living  by  wandering  around and getting catches, sometimes good - sometimes bad. And as you grew, Jussa got older.  One  night  he asked you to swear that you'd take care of his traps and use them after he had died. You  swore it and that night Jussa told you that those traps had been in his family for so many generations that no-one could remember their number. "There's a special kind of spirit  in this  shovel  and  these traps", Jussa said, "that may not be abandoned. Remember that." After a few happy years Jussa finally died and his equipment was left to  you.  You  were  once again alone in the world, except for the legacy you carried with you in the traps and  the  shovel of Jussa's family - towards which you now felt deep togetherness. (Your character is equipped with various traps and tools to make traps including wooden stakes for building fences and a shovel. Even if you can't make your livelihood immediately learning to  use traps can be very interesting. Remember to see game info about TRAPS.)
translation: 你是个养子。四五岁时，一位年老的设陷猎人在森林中的巡陷小道旁发现了你，随后将你养大。你的确切年龄与身世一样成谜，因为你完全不记得遇见养父之前的生活，而他也无法提供什么线索。养父尤萨（Jussa）收留你的唯一原因，是自己年事已高，又没有儿子。尤萨是位熟练的设陷猎人，过着隐士般的生活，避免与任何人来往。他最希望的是，自己死后，亲手制作的陷阱仍有人使用。自然而然地，你对陷阱产生了兴趣，也学着四处巡行、靠时好时坏的收获谋生。你渐渐长大，尤萨也渐渐老去。一天夜里，他让你发誓，在他死后照管并继续使用那些陷阱。你答应了。那晚，尤萨告诉你，这些陷阱已经在家族中传承了许多代，久到没人记得究竟多少代。“这把铲和这些陷阱里，有一种特别的精灵。”尤萨说，“绝不能抛弃它。记住这一点。”又过了几年幸福的日子，尤萨终于离世，把装备留给了你。你再次孤身面对世界，唯有尤萨家传的陷阱与铲子中承载的遗产与你相伴；如今，你对它们有了深深的亲近与归属感。（你的角色配有多种陷阱和制陷工具，包括建造围栏的木桩和铲子。即使暂时还不能靠它们谋生，学习使用陷阱也会很有趣。记得查阅游戏百科中的 TRAPS（陷阱）。）

original: I WANT TO BE A FISHERMAN
translation: 我要当渔夫

original: Scenario: I WANT TO BE A FISHERMAN
translation: 开局：我要当渔夫

original: Carrying extensive fishing equipment you start to follow your path as a fisherman.
translation: 你带着齐全的捕鱼装备，开始踏上渔夫之路。

original: In your childhood you used to go fishing with your uncle. From him  you  learned  to  respect  the guardian spirits of the water and were always fascinated when he  sacrificed  some  fish  to  them after a good catch. You began to admire the power of the water and dreamed  of  becoming  a  great fisherman one day. Once you and your uncle got a poor catch and your uncle didn't want to  sacrifice  any  fish  as your village was starving. "But uncle... maybe you still should..." you tried to say. "Quiet now!" he interrupted you, "We must row home." Before you got to the shore you were caught in a sudden storm and your punt  capsized.  All  the fish you had caught, along with you and your uncle, fell into the water. You managed  to  swim  to the shore but your uncle was mad and he put it on you. "He should never fish again - the guardian spirits of the water don't like him", he  declared to the people - and you were never allowed to go fishing again. The time went by but you didn't give up your dream. You often used to sit on the shore  watching the water and talking to it. You always thought that there wouldn't have  been  a  storm  if  your uncle had sacrificed even one fish. One night you sneaked into the fishing shed and took all the equipment you could carry.  "I know enough to make my living by fishing alone", you mumbled as you left your home for good.  The  days after that weren't easy but little by little you began to learn to use  you  your  fishing  tackle better - and the further you travelled the more friendly the waters seemed to be.
translation: 小时候，你常跟叔叔去捕鱼。他教你敬重水的守护精灵。每次丰收后，他会献出一些鱼，你总是看得入迷。你渐渐敬畏水的力量，梦想有一天成为出色的渔夫。有一次，你和叔叔收获不佳，村里又正在挨饿，叔叔便不愿献鱼。“可是叔叔……也许还是应该……”你试着说。“别说了！”他打断你，“我们得划船回家。”还没到岸边，一场突如其来的暴风雨便袭来，平底船翻了。捕到的鱼、你和叔叔，全都落入水中。你设法游到了岸上，叔叔却勃然大怒，把责任推到你身上。“他再也不该捕鱼——水的守护精灵不喜欢他。”他向人们宣称。从此，你再也不被允许捕鱼。时光流逝，你却没有放弃梦想。你常坐在岸边望着水面，与水说话。你始终认为，只要叔叔哪怕献出一条鱼，暴风雨也不会发生。一天夜里，你溜进渔具棚，拿走了所有带得动的装备。“我懂得够多了，独自捕鱼也能养活自己。”你低声说着，永远离开了家。之后的日子并不容易，但你渐渐学会了更熟练地使用渔具；而你走得越远，水域似乎也变得越发友善。

original: ABANDONED TRAP-FENCE
translation: 废弃的陷阱围栏

original: Scenario: ABANDONED TRAP-FENCE
translation: 开局：废弃的陷阱围栏

original: You find an old trap-fence in the wilderness.
translation: 你在荒野中发现一处旧陷阱围栏。

original: You had been checking trap-fences with the men of your home village and one of them, set for  wild reindeers, had turned out to be very succesful. At the end of the day you were tired from  cutting and skinning the catch. Your next trap-fence was two day's journey away but as you now had so much to carry, you thought that maybe only one of you should go to check it then come back to report. You were willing to take on this task and even though all of the men  weren't  sure  if  you, a young man at the age of sixteen, could find your own way, you were finally allowed go alone. The first day of your journey went well. You  recognized  familiar  landmarks  easily  and  the weather was beautiful. The night fell and you set up your camp, but your sleep  was  restless  and you kept waking up hearing silent rustling all around you. Finally you couldn't sleep at  all  and sat up, packed your things and started to wait for the day to break to be able to move on. Sitting in the grey dawn you suddenly heard a loud shriek nearby.  You jumped up trying to look around. The trees were swaying like they were about to fall down at  any  minute.  Then  something pushed you from behind, forcing you down on your knees. Terrified, you started to scramble away... You ran until dawn and as you finally stopped you realised  that  you  had  got  lost.  As  you scouted around trying to recognize the region, you finally  arrived  at  an  abandoned  trap-fence which wasn't the one you were looking for.  Still  confused of the nocturnal incident you wondered where you were and whose this age-old trap-fence was... and had you  been  brought  here  by  mere chance or was there some meaning behind all this? (This scenario gives you an idea of what  kind  of  trap-fences  you  should  build  yourself  and encourages you to learn by using this starting trap-fence.  It  will   only  need  repairing  and improvement rather than construction from scratch by yourself.)
translation: 你与村中的男人一起巡查陷阱围栏，其中一处用于捕捉野生驯鹿的围栏收获颇丰。一天下来，你剥皮切肉，早已疲惫不堪。下一处围栏还有两天路程，可如今要携带的东西太多，于是你们觉得，也许只派一个人前去检查，再回来报告会更好。你愿意承担这个任务。虽然并非所有人都相信你这个十六岁的少年能独自认路，但最终还是允许你单独出发。第一天一路顺利。熟悉的地标很容易辨认，天气也很好。夜幕降临，你扎下营地，却睡得很不安稳，四周轻微的窸窣声让你不断惊醒。最后，你再也睡不着，索性坐起来收拾行装，等天亮后继续上路。坐在灰蒙蒙的晨光里，你突然听见附近传来一声尖啸。你猛地跳起来，试图看清四周。树木摇晃，仿佛随时都会倒下。接着，有什么从背后推了你一把，迫使你双膝跪地。恐惧之中，你挣扎着逃开……你一直跑到破晓，终于停下时，才发现自己迷路了。你四处探查，试图辨认这片地区，最后来到一处废弃的陷阱围栏前，但那并不是你要找的。你仍对夜里的遭遇困惑不解，猜想着自己身在何处，这座年代久远的围栏属于谁……来到这里究竟只是偶然，还是另有深意？（这个开局能让你了解应当建造怎样的陷阱围栏，并鼓励你通过使用现成的围栏来学习。你只需维修和改进它，而不必从零开始建造。）

original: ABANDONED CAMP
translation: 废弃营地

original: Scenario: ABANDONED CAMP
translation: 开局：废弃营地

original: You find an old camp with a shelter, firewood and useful items.
translation: 你发现一处旧营地，里面有庇护所、柴火和实用物品。

original: As you were wandering through the wilderness you found a camp.  As  you  explored,  you  saw  that there was a perfectly usable shelter for rainy nights, some  ready  chopped  firewood  and  a  few interesting items. This would be a good place for you to spend some time  and  make  journeys  and hunting trips. (What brought you here and what kind of your past is like is a matter of your imagination. You are at a camp where to ponder about the path to take. You can take items lying around as a  hint,  or you can make a fire and throw them into it one by one... as always everything is up to you.)
translation: 你在荒野中行走时，发现了一处营地。查看之后，你看见这里有一座完全可用、能在雨夜遮身的庇护所，一些劈好的柴火，以及几件有趣的物品。这里很适合暂住，也能作为出行和狩猎的据点。（你为何来到这里，过去又经历了什么，都由你的想象决定。如今你身处营地，可以思考接下来要走哪条路。你可以把散落的物品当作提示，也可以生起火，将它们一件件扔进去……一如既往，一切由你决定。）

original:
Your character possesses the following selection of cultural and family skills which can be now developed further. You have number of options to assign to the skills you prefer. Select a skill from the list and press [+] or [-] to improve or degrade it.

The darker section of skill meter bar, if visible, shows your initial skill mastery.

Your natural aptitude for learning and developing a skill is rated by stars *. This is determined by your physical and mental attributes and affects the level of skill improvement.
translation:
你的角色拥有以下文化和家族技能，现在可以进一步提升。你可以选择多项技能进行调整。选中列表中的技能，然后按[+]或[-]来提升或降低它。

如果技能条中显示较深的部分，它代表角色初始的技能掌握程度。

角色学习和提升技能的天赋以星星*表示。该天赋由身体和精神属性决定，并会影响技能提升幅度。

original:
These are the spells and magic means currently known to you.
Bring the selector over the desired spell to view its description.
Most often the spells are performed by following the instructions and doing the required actions given in the spell description.
translation:
这些是你目前已知的法术和魔法手段。
将选择光标移到所需法术上，即可查看说明。
大多数时候，只需遵循法术说明中的指示并完成要求的动作即可施法。

original: These are the quests you are currently involved in. Select a quest from the list to view it in detail.
translation: 这些是你目前正在进行的任务。从列表中选择一项任务，即可查看详细信息。

original:
These colors indicate the state of your injuries. The state of fresh wounds is not known until they have been treated - or have started to heal on their own.
BL abbreviation is used for bleeding wounds.

The TREATED bar shows how many of all the possible treatments have been applied to the wound today. Wounds can be treated on a daily basis by using the PHYSICIAN skill.
translation:
这些颜色表示伤势的状态。新鲜伤口在得到处理或开始自行愈合之前，无法判断其状况。
BL 是流血伤口的缩写。

TREATED（已处理）栏显示今天对伤口进行了多少种可能的处理。可以每天使用 PHYSICIAN（医术）技能治疗伤口。

original:
You start with these spells and magic means to interact and communicate with the spirits and the otherworld. You'll learn more during your life.
Exit this screen when you are ready to continue character creation or take a moment to learn more by bringing the selector over the desired spell to view its description.
translation:
你初始就掌握这些法术和魔法手段，可以用来与精灵和异界互动、交流。今后的人生中你还会学到更多。
准备好继续创建角色时，请退出此界面；也可以将选择器移到感兴趣的法术上查看说明，花些时间进一步了解。

original: There's more information available about highlighted topics. To display a page, choose and select the topic by using the cursor keys and ENTER - or by clicking with the mouse. You can also type a free keyword/topic to search for a specific page.
translation: 高亮主题还有更多相关信息。若要查看页面，请使用光标键移动到主题并按 ENTER 选择，也可以用鼠标点击。你还可以输入自由关键词或主题，搜索特定页面。

original: Invocations and rituals marked with this color work differently and are automatically performed upon selection.
translation: 以此颜色标记的祈祷和仪式，施行方式有所不同，选中后会自动施行。

original:
Select a skill from the list to use it.

From the main game screen you can use skills quickly by pressing simultaneously:
[ALT]+[skill hotkey a-z]



Skills that have improved during the present day are marked with+.

The darker section of skill meter bar, if visible, shows your original skill mastery.

Your natural aptitude for learning and developing a skill is rated by stars: *.
This is determined by your physical and mental attributes and affects the pace of skill improvement.
translation:
从列表中选择一项技能来使用。

在主游戏画面中，同时按下以下按键即可快速使用技能：
[ALT]+[技能快捷键 a-z]



当天有所提升的技能会以+标记。

如果可见，技能条中颜色较深的部分表示原有的技能熟练度。

你学习和发展技能的天赋以星级表示：*。
这取决于你的身体和精神属性，并影响技能提升速度。

original: Click locations with mouse for more information, where available. Or use arrow keys to move target cursor, when visible, and select the location with [ENTER].
translation: 在可用的情况下，用鼠标点击地点查看更多信息。或者在目标光标显示时使用方向键移动光标，再按[ENTER]选择地点。
